title: 美联储副主席杰斐逊：政策调整或需更多时间，市场降息预期还能兑现吗？

segments.en: I see economic activity and labor market conditions remaining broadly solid while inflation remains
segments.zh: 我认为经济活动和劳动力市场状况总体稳健，而通胀仍高于目标。

segments.en: prices, the surging AI build-out and changes to trade policy. We do not have the luxury of considering
segments.zh: 我们无法孤立地考虑每一个冲击。相反，在制定政策以实现双重使命目标时，必须考虑这一连串冲击可能如何影响整个经济。

segments.en: each of these shocks in isolation. Rather, we must consider how this cascade might affect the entire
segments.zh: 展望未来，我的观点是，未来任何政策调整都应通过仔细审视数据趋势、不断变化的前景和风险平衡来决定。

segments.en: economy when setting policy to achieve outdoor mandated objectives. As we look ahead,
segments.zh: 自9月会议以来，各期限收益率进一步上升，表明市场参与者正在重新评估不断变化的宏观经济格局。

segments.en: my view is that any future adjustments in policy should be determined by carefully examining trends
segments.zh: 我和同事们需要做出自己的判断，这可能需要更多时间。

segments.en: in the data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risk. Since our September meeting, yields across the term structure have increased further,

segments.en: My colleagues and I will need to come to our own judgment, which may take more time.
